tools.name: get_page_references
tools.description: Read published parent, child and related editorial pages. Index pages use id index. Related links work in both directions.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search published destinations and collections by keyword. Returns existing text, not live offers or generated answers.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List editorial gateway cities with their ids. Some cities have no reviewed app offers. Call first; other tools need a destinationId from this list.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List published editorial collections. Product ids and partner links are limited to reviewed app inventory.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Read one published collection by slug, including its experience ids and optional destination guide with image credits and sources.

tools.name: get_collection_experiences

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_experiences, get_experience, get_reviews, get_booking_link, create_share_list · Private data: create_share_list · Public sink: create_share_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_experiences, get_experience, get_reviews, get_booking_link, create_share_list · Private data: create_share_list · Public sink: create_share_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_destinations" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the approved city destinations with their ids. Call first; other tools need a destinationId from this list." → after: "List editorial gateway cities with their ids. Some cities have no reviewed app offers. Call first; other tools need a destinationId from this list."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
